note: Concepts v7: short definitions and significant theorem statements. Proof maneuvers are source notes, not concept records. Includes draft extractions from the G₂ and non-cyclotomic fusion category papers. Includes one frozen layer of prerequisites for the non-cyclotomic paper. Includes recursive prerequisite reviews to an explicit elementary baseline; certifications are separate curation judgments.

concepts.title: Finite set
concepts.description: A set X is finite if it is bijective with {1,…,n} for some natural number n≥0; its cardinality is n.

concepts.title: Integer
concepts.description: An integer is an element of the ordered ring ℤ, obtained by adjoining additive inverses to the natural numbers.

concepts.title: Real number
concepts.description: A real number is an element of a complete ordered field ℝ; completeness means every nonempty subset bounded above has a least upper bound.

concepts.title: Real sequence
concepts.description: A real sequence is a function a:ℕ₊→ℝ, written (aₙ)ₙ≥1.

concepts.title: Limit of a real sequence
concepts.description: A sequence (aₙ) converges to L∈ℝ if for every ε>0 there is N such that n≥N implies abs(aₙ−L)<ε.

concepts.title: Convergent real series
concepts.description: The series ∑ₙ≥1aₙ converges to S if its sequence of partial sums converges to S.

concepts.title: Sum of a nonnegative series
concepts.description: For aₙ≥0, define ∑ₙ≥1aₙ as the supremum of its finite partial sums; the value may be infinite.

concepts.title: Factorial domination of fixed exponentials
concepts.description: For every fixed real C>0, the sequence Cⁿ/n! tends to zero.

concepts.title: Real polynomial
concepts.description: A real polynomial is a finite sum ∑ⱼ₌₀ᵐaⱼxʲ with real coefficients and nonnegative integer m.

concepts.title: Integer polynomial
concepts.description: An integer polynomial is a real polynomial all of whose coefficients lie in ℤ.

concepts.title: Derivative of a real function
concepts.description: The derivative f′(x) is the finite limit of (f(x+h)−f(x))/h as h→0, when it exists. Higher derivatives are defined by iteration.

concepts.title: Riemann integral
concepts.description: A bounded f:[a,b]→ℝ has Riemann integral I if all tagged Riemann sums approach I as the maximum length of the partition intervals tends to zero.

concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of calculus for continuous integrands
concepts.description: If f is continuous on [a,b], then F(x)=∫ₐˣf(t)dt has derivative f on (a,b); any antiderivative G of f satisfies ∫ₐᵇf=G(b)−G(a).

concepts.title: Integration by parts for C¹ real functions
concepts.description: For u,v∈C¹([a,b]), ∫ₐᵇuv′=u(b)v(b)−u(a)v(a)−∫ₐᵇu′v.

concepts.title: Rational number
concepts.description: A real x is rational if x=a/b for integers a,b with b≠0; otherwise it is irrational.

concepts.title: Real sine function
concepts.description: The sine function is defined by the everywhere convergent power series sin(x)=∑ₖ≥0(−1)ᵏx²ᵏ⁺¹/(2k+1)!.

concepts.title: π
concepts.description: π is the least positive zero of the real sine function and equals the circumference-to-diameter ratio of a Euclidean circle.

concepts.title: Irrationality of π
concepts.description: There are no integers a,b with b≠0 such that π=a/b.

concepts.title: Cesàro convergence theorem
concepts.description: If aₙ→L, then (a₁+···+aₙ)/n→L.

concepts.title: Prime number
concepts.description: An integer p>1 is prime if its only positive divisors are 1 and p.

concepts.title: Congruence modulo an integer
concepts.description: The relation a≡b (mod m) means that m divides a−b.

concepts.title: Involution of a finite set
concepts.description: An involution of a finite set X is a map f:X→X with f(f(x))=x for all x∈X.

concepts.title: Fixed point of a self-map
concepts.description: A fixed point of f:X→X is an x∈X satisfying f(x)=x. The fixed-point set is Fix(f)={x∈X:f(x)=x}.

concepts.title: Fixed-point parity lemma for finite involutions
concepts.description: If f is an involution of a finite set X, then X and Fix(f) have the same cardinality modulo two.

concepts.title: Zagier's involution
concepts.description: For a prime p≡1 (mod 4), let Sₚ={(x,y,z)∈ℤ₊³:x²+4yz=p}. Send (x,y,z) to (x+2z,z,y−x−z) if x<y−z, to (2y−x,y,x−y+z) if y−z<x<2y, and to (x−2y,x−y+z,y) if x>2y. These cases exhaust Sₚ and define an involution with the unique fixed point (1,1,(p−1)/4).

concepts.title: Fermat's two-square theorem
concepts.description: A prime p is a²+b² for integers a,b if and only if p=2 or p≡1 (mod 4).

concepts.title: Euclidean space ℝᵈ
concepts.description: For d≥1, ℝᵈ consists of d-tuples of real numbers with distance dist(x,y)=(∑ᵢ(xᵢ−yᵢ)²)¹ᐟ².

concepts.title: Convex subset of ℝᵈ
concepts.description: C⊆ℝᵈ is convex if (1−t)x+ty∈C whenever x,y∈C and 0≤t≤1.

concepts.title: Convex hull
concepts.description: The smallest convex set containing a given set of points.

concepts.title: Convex position
concepts.description: A finite P⊂ℝ² is in convex position if no point of P is in the convex hull of the other points.

concepts.title: General position for planar point sets
concepts.description: A finite P⊂ℝ² is in general position here if no three distinct points of P lie on one line.

concepts.title: Coloring of r-element subsets
concepts.description: An r-subset coloring is a map from the r-element subsets of X to C.

concepts.title: Homogeneous set for a subset coloring
concepts.description: H⊆X is homogeneous for c if c is constant on the r-element subsets of H.

concepts.title: Finite Ramsey theorem for uniform subset colorings
concepts.description: For integers r≥1 and s,t≥r, there is N such that every red–blue coloring of r-subsets of an N-element set has a red-homogeneous s-set or a blue-homogeneous t-set.

concepts.title: Two-color uniform Ramsey number Rᵣ(s,t)
concepts.description: Rᵣ(s,t) is the least N such that every red–blue r-subset coloring on N elements has a red-homogeneous s-set or a blue-homogeneous t-set; set it to ∞ if there is no such N.

concepts.title: Finite simple undirected graph
concepts.description: A finite simple graph is (V,E), where V is finite and E is a set of two-element subsets of V.

concepts.title: Clique
concepts.description: A set of vertices of a graph, every two of which are adjacent.

concepts.title: Independent set in a graph
concepts.description: A set of vertices in a graph containing no edge.

concepts.title: Monotone subsequence
concepts.description: A strictly increasing subsequence has indices i₁<···<iₖ and values aᵢ₁<···<aᵢₖ; a decreasing subsequence reverses the value comparisons and retains increasing indices.

concepts.title: Erdős–Szekeres monotone subsequence theorem
concepts.description: For integers r,s≥2, every sequence of (r−1)(s−1)+1 distinct real numbers has an increasing subsequence of length r or a decreasing subsequence of length s, both strict. The threshold is sharp.

concepts.title: Cups and caps of planar point sets
concepts.description: For planar points p₁,…,pₖ with strictly increasing x-coordinates, a k-cup has strictly increasing successive slopes, and a k-cap has strictly decreasing successive slopes.

concepts.title: Binomial coefficient
concepts.description: For integers 0≤k≤n, binom(n,k) counts the k-element subsets of an n-element set and equals n!/(k!(n−k)!).

concepts.title: Erdős–Szekeres cups–caps theorem
concepts.description: For r,s≥3, any binom(r+s−4,r−2)+1 planar points with no three collinear and with distinct x-coordinates contain an r-cup or an s-cap. This threshold is sharp for the cups–caps problem.

concepts.title: Erdős–Szekeres convex polygon theorem
concepts.description: For each n≥3 there is N such that every planar set of at least N points in general position contains n points in convex position. The 1935 proof gives N≤binom(2n−4,n−2)+1.

concepts.title: Esther Klein's five-point theorem
concepts.description: Every set of five planar points in general position contains four points in convex position.

concepts.title: Monotone-gap selection theorem for points on a line
concepts.description: For r,s≥2, any binom(r+s−4,r−2)+1 distinct points on a line contain r points with nondecreasing consecutive gaps or s points with nonincreasing consecutive gaps.

concepts.title: Rooted finitely branching tree
concepts.description: A rooted tree is a connected acyclic graph with a distinguished root. It is finitely branching if every vertex has finitely many children, meaning adjacent vertices one edge farther from the root.

concepts.title: König's infinity lemma
concepts.description: Every infinite rooted finitely branching tree has an infinite simple path starting at its root.

concepts.title: Geometric n-simplex
concepts.description: An n-simplex is conv(v₀,…,vₙ), where v₁−v₀,…,vₙ−v₀ are linearly independent. Its faces are the hulls of subsets of its vertices.

concepts.title: Triangulation of a geometric simplex
concepts.description: A triangulation of S is a finite collection of simplices covering S, closed under faces, such that any two members intersect in a common face or not at all.

concepts.title: Barycentric subdivision
concepts.description: Vertices are the barycenters b(F) of nonempty faces F; a simplex corresponds to a chain F₀⊊···⊊Fₖ and has vertices b(F₀),…,b(Fₖ).

concepts.title: Sperner labeling of a triangulated simplex
concepts.description: For S=conv(v₀,…,vₙ), label each triangulation vertex by an element of {0,…,n}; a vertex on conv(vᵢ:i∈I) must have a label in I.

concepts.title: Sperner's lemma
concepts.description: Every Sperner-labeled triangulation of an n-simplex has an odd number of elementary n-simplices carrying all n+1 labels. In particular there is at least one.

concepts.title: Dual Sperner labeling on a barycentrically subdivided simplex
concepts.description: On a barycentric subdivision of the standard n-simplex Δⁿ, n≥1, label vertices by {0,…,n}. A boundary vertex x must receive a label i with xᵢ=0; interior labels are unrestricted.

concepts.title: Dual Sperner lemma for barycentric subdivisions
concepts.description: For m≥1, the m-fold barycentric subdivision of a simplex satisfying the dual zero-coordinate boundary labeling rule contains an elementary n-simplex with all n+1 labels.

concepts.title: Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem in ℝᵈ
concepts.description: Every bounded sequence in Euclidean space ℝᵈ has a subsequence converging coordinatewise to a point of ℝᵈ.

concepts.title: Closed preference correspondence with finite alternatives
concepts.description: For metric X and finite alternatives A, P:X→nonempty subsets of A is a closed preference correspondence if {x:a∈P(x)} is closed in X for every a∈A. Ties are allowed.

concepts.title: Envy-free allocation of finitely many shares
concepts.description: An allocation is envy-free if each participant weakly prefers their own assigned share to every other share, evaluated at that same allocation.

concepts.title: Envy-free interval cake division theorem
concepts.description: For n participants and consecutive pieces of [0,1] parametrized by Δⁿ⁻¹, suppose preferred-piece sets are nonempty and closed and exclude empty pieces whenever a positive-length piece exists. Then some partition admits a bijection assigning every participant a preferred piece.

concepts.title: Su's rental harmony theorem
concepts.description: For n participants and rooms, let pᵢ≥0 and ∑pᵢ=R>0. Suppose preferred-room sets are nonempty and closed, and contain only free rooms whenever some room is free. Then some price vector admits a bijection assigning every participant a preferred room.

concepts.title: Envy-free division of an interval of chores
concepts.description: For n participants and consecutive chore pieces parametrized by Δⁿ⁻¹, suppose preferred-piece sets are nonempty and closed and contain only empty pieces whenever an empty piece is available. Then there is a partition and bijection assigning each participant a preferred piece.

concepts.title: Brouwer fixed-point theorem
concepts.description: Every continuous f:Δⁿ→Δⁿ has a fixed point. The equivalent closed-ball formulation belongs to this same theorem concept.
aliases: Brouwer fixed-point theorem for a closed ball

concepts.title: σ-algebra
concepts.description: A σ-algebra on Ω contains Ω and is closed under complements in Ω and countable unions.

concepts.title: Measure
concepts.description: A measure μ maps a σ-algebra to [0,∞], sends ∅ to 0, and satisfies μ(⋃ₙAₙ)=∑ₙμ(Aₙ) for every pairwise disjoint sequence of measurable sets.

concepts.title: Lebesgue integral
concepts.description: For measurable f≥0, ∫f dμ is the supremum of integrals of nonnegative simple functions below f. For signed f with ∫abs(f)dμ<∞, define ∫f=∫f⁺−∫f⁻.

concepts.title: Probability space
concepts.description: A probability space is (Ω,𝔽,P), where 𝔽 is a σ-algebra on Ω and P is a measure on 𝔽 with P(Ω)=1.

concepts.title: Real-valued random variable
concepts.description: A real-valued random variable is a measurable map from a probability space to ℝ with its Borel σ-algebra.

concepts.title: Distribution of a real random variable
concepts.description: The distribution μₓ of X is defined by μₓ(B)=P(X∈B) for Borel B⊆ℝ.

concepts.title: Expectation of an integrable real random variable
concepts.description: If E abs(X)=∫abs(X)dP<∞, the expectation of X is EX=∫X dP.

concepts.title: Variance of a real random variable
concepts.description: If EX²<∞, then Var(X)=E[(X−EX)²].

concepts.title: Pairwise independent random variables
concepts.description: A family (Xᵢ) is pairwise independent if P(Xᵢ∈A,Xⱼ∈B)=P(Xᵢ∈A)P(Xⱼ∈B) for all i≠j and Borel A,B⊆ℝ.

concepts.title: Independent family of random variables
concepts.description: For distinct i₁,…,iₖ and Borel A₁,…,Aₖ, independence requires P(⋂ⱼ{Xᵢⱼ∈Aⱼ})=∏ⱼP(Xᵢⱼ∈Aⱼ).

concepts.title: Identically distributed random variables
concepts.description: A family is identically distributed when all its random variables have the same distribution.

concepts.title: Almost-sure convergence of real random variables
concepts.description: Xₙ→X almost surely means P({ω:limₙXₙ(ω)=X(ω)})=1.

concepts.title: Chebyshev's inequality
concepts.description: If EX²<∞ and t>0, then P(abs(X−EX)≥t)≤Var(X)/t².

concepts.title: First Borel–Cantelli lemma
concepts.description: If ∑ₙP(Aₙ)<∞, then P(⋂ₘ⋃ₙ≥ₘAₙ)=0: almost surely only finitely many Aₙ occur.

concepts.title: Monotone convergence theorem for Lebesgue integrals
concepts.description: If 0≤fₙ≤fₙ₊₁ and fₙ→f pointwise, then ∫fₙdμ increases to ∫f dμ, allowing infinity.

concepts.title: Etemadi's strong law of large numbers
concepts.description: If (Xₙ) is pairwise independent and identically distributed with E abs(X₁)<∞, then (X₁+···+Xₙ)/n→EX₁ almost surely.

concepts.title: Kolmogorov's strong law for iid real random variables
concepts.description: If (Xₙ) is jointly independent and identically distributed with E abs(X₁)<∞, then (X₁+···+Xₙ)/n→EX₁ almost surely.

concepts.title: Kolmogorov's maximal inequality
concepts.description: If X₁,…,Xₙ are independent with EXᵢ=0 and EXᵢ²<∞, then for λ>0, P(max₁≤ₖ≤ₙ abs(∑ᵢ≤ₖXᵢ)≥λ)≤(∑ᵢ≤ₙVar(Xᵢ))/λ².

concepts.title: Rectangular average of a real random array
concepts.description: For positive integer indices, the rectangular average at (n₁,…,nᵣ) is (∏ⱼnⱼ)⁻¹∑₁≤ᵢⱼ≤ₙⱼXᵢ₁,…,ᵢᵣ. Its joint limit means that every nⱼ tends to infinity.

concepts.title: L(log L)ᵏ moment condition
concepts.description: X∈L(log L)ᵏ means E[abs(X)(log⁺abs(X))ᵏ]<∞, where log⁺t=max(0,log t) for t>0 and log⁺0=0.

concepts.title: Divisor function d(n)
concepts.description: d(n) is the number of positive divisors of n, equivalently the number of ordered positive integer pairs (a,b) satisfying ab=n.

concepts.title: Divisor summatory bound ∑ₙ≤ₓd(n)=O(x log x)
concepts.description: There is an absolute constant C such that ∑₁≤ₙ≤ₓd(n)≤Cx log x for x≥2; the sum counts positive integer pairs (a,b) with ab≤x.

concepts.title: Abel's summation formula
concepts.description: If Aₖ=∑ⱼ₌₁ᵏaⱼ, then ∑ₖ₌₁ᴺaₖbₖ=A_N b_N+∑ₖ₌₁ᴺ⁻¹Aₖ(bₖ−bₖ₊₁).

concepts.title: Etemadi's strong law for random arrays
concepts.description: For an r-indexed pairwise independent identically distributed real array with E[abs(X)(log⁺abs(X))ʳ⁻¹]<∞, its rectangular averages converge almost surely to EX as every side length tends to infinity.

concepts.title: k-linear category
concepts.description: A category whose morphism spaces are vector spaces over a field k and whose composition is k-bilinear. This convention does not require finite sums or a zero object.

concepts.title: Monoidal category
concepts.description: A category C with a tensor bifunctor C×C→C, a unit object, and natural associativity and unit isomorphisms satisfying the pentagon and triangle identities.

concepts.title: Rigid monoidal category
concepts.description: A monoidal category in which every object has left and right duals, with evaluation and coevaluation maps satisfying the zigzag identities.

concepts.title: Braided monoidal category
concepts.description: A monoidal category with natural isomorphisms c(X,Y):X⊗Y→Y⊗X satisfying the two hexagon identities.

concepts.title: Pivotal category
concepts.description: A rigid monoidal category with a monoidal natural isomorphism from the identity functor to the double-dual functor.

concepts.title: Ribbon category
concepts.description: A braided rigid monoidal category with a twist compatible with both the braiding and duality.

concepts.title: Trace in a pivotal monoidal category
concepts.description: Closing an endomorphism using evaluation, coevaluation and the pivotal structure gives its left and right traces, which lie in End(1). They are scalars when End(1) is the ground field; the two traces need not agree.

concepts.title: Karoubi envelope of a category
concepts.description: The category obtained by formally splitting idempotent endomorphisms. Its objects are pairs (X,e) with e²=e; a map (X,e)→(Y,f) is a map a:X→Y with a=fae.

concepts.title: Negligible morphism in a spherical linear category
concepts.description: In a spherical k-linear category with End(1)=k, f:X→Y is negligible if tr(gf)=0 for every g:Y→X. Such morphisms form a tensor ideal.

concepts.title: Semisimplification by negligible morphisms
concepts.description: Quotient a spherical linear category by its negligible morphisms and take the Karoubi envelope. Under the usual finiteness and nondegeneracy hypotheses this gives a semisimple category; the construction does not guarantee semisimplicity for an arbitrary pivotal category.

concepts.title: Simple object in an abelian category
concepts.description: A nonzero object whose only subobjects are zero and itself.

concepts.title: Semisimple abelian category
concepts.description: An abelian category in which every object is a finite direct sum of simple objects.

concepts.title: Split simple object in a k-linear abelian category
concepts.description: A simple object X in a k-linear abelian category is split if its scalar map k→End(X) is an isomorphism.

concepts.title: Split semisimple k-linear category
concepts.description: A semisimple k-linear abelian category in which every simple object is split.

concepts.title: Primitive idempotent in an algebra
concepts.description: A nonzero idempotent that is not a sum of two nonzero orthogonal idempotents. In a finite-dimensional semisimple algebra A, e is primitive exactly when the left ideal Ae is a simple A-module.

concepts.title: Schur's lemma
concepts.description: A nonzero morphism between simple objects of an abelian category is an isomorphism. Consequently, the endomorphism ring of a simple object is a division ring.

concepts.title: Braid group
concepts.description: Bₙ is generated by σ₁,…,σₙ₋₁, with σᵢσⱼ=σⱼσᵢ for abs(i−j)>1 and σᵢσᵢ₊₁σᵢ=σᵢ₊₁σᵢσᵢ₊₁.

concepts.title: Group algebra
concepts.description: For a group G and field k, k[G] consists of finite k-linear combinations of group elements, with multiplication extending the group law bilinearly.

concepts.title: Hopf algebra
concepts.description: A unital associative algebra H with coassociative coproduct Δ:H→H⊗H and counit ε:H→k that are algebra homomorphisms, and an antipode S satisfying m(S⊗id)Δ=m(id⊗S)Δ=ηε, where m and η are multiplication and unit.

concepts.title: Lie algebra 𝔤₂
concepts.description: The 14-dimensional complex simple Lie algebra of exceptional type G₂.

concepts.title: Quantum group U_q(𝔤₂)
concepts.description: The Drinfeld–Jimbo quantized enveloping algebra of 𝔤₂; in the braid-generation theorem q is indeterminate and the coefficient field is ℂ(q).

concepts.title: Seven-dimensional fundamental representation of U_q(𝔤₂)
concepts.description: The irreducible fundamental U_q(𝔤₂)-module of dimension seven, deforming the smallest nontrivial representation of 𝔤₂.

concepts.title: Intertwiner of algebra representations
concepts.description: A linear map T between modules over an algebra A such that T(av)=aT(v) for every a∈A and v in the source module.

concepts.title: Tensor power of a Hopf-algebra representation
concepts.description: The representation on V⊗n obtained by applying the iterated coproduct before acting on its n factors.

concepts.title: Centralizer algebra of a representation
concepts.description: For an H-module W, End_H(W) is the algebra of linear endomorphisms commuting with H; multiplication is composition.

concepts.title: Universal R-matrix
concepts.description: An invertible element R in a suitable completion of H⊗H that conjugates the coproduct to its opposite and satisfies the two coproduct compatibility identities; on modules, flip∘R gives a braiding.

concepts.title: Braid-group action on a tensor power
concepts.description: For an object V in a braided monoidal category, σᵢ acts on V⊗n as the braiding c(V,V) on factors i,i+1 and the identity on all other factors.

concepts.title: Strongly multiplicity-free highest-weight representation
concepts.description: A finite-dimensional irreducible highest-weight representation of a complex semisimple Lie algebra or its generic Drinfeld–Jimbo quantum group, with one-dimensional weight spaces and weights totally ordered by the root order. The root order compares weights whose difference is a nonnegative integral combination of simple roots.

concepts.title: Kuperberg's G₂ spider
concepts.description: The ℂ(q)-linear tensor category presented by planar G₂ webs and Kuperberg's local relations. The paper uses its single-edge trivalent presentation generated by the seven-dimensional module.

concepts.title: G₂ web
concepts.description: A planar trivalent graph with specified boundary endpoints, interpreted as a morphism in the G₂ spider; closed loop components are allowed.

concepts.title: Non-elliptic G₂ web
concepts.description: A G₂ web with no closed loop components and with at least six edges on every internal face.

concepts.title: Euler measure of a surface with assigned corner angles
concepts.description: For a compact surface F with finitely many assigned boundary corner angles θᵢ, its Euler measure is e(F)=χ(F)−∑ᵢ(π−θᵢ)/(2π). Smooth portions of the boundary contribute no corner correction.

concepts.title: Tilting module for a quantum group
concepts.description: A finite-dimensional module admitting both a filtration by Weyl modules and a filtration by dual Weyl modules.

concepts.title: Kuperberg's G₂ web-basis theorem
concepts.description: Over ℂ(q), each morphism space in the G₂ spider has a basis consisting of the non-elliptic webs.

concepts.title: Kuperberg's G₂ spider equivalence theorem
concepts.description: Over ℂ(q), the G₂ spider is equivalent, as a braided tensor category, to the category whose objects are tensor powers of the seven-dimensional U_q(𝔤₂)-module and whose morphisms are intertwiners.

concepts.title: Braid generation of the G₂ tensor centralizer
concepts.description: For the seven-dimensional U_q(𝔤₂)-module V over ℂ(q), the R-matrix representation induces a surjective algebra map ℂ(q)[Bₙ]→End_{U_q(𝔤₂)}(V⊗n) for every n.

concepts.title: Lehrer–Zhang braid-generation theorem
concepts.description: For a strongly multiplicity-free irreducible representation V of a generic Drinfeld–Jimbo quantum group, the braid-group image generates End_U(V⊗n) as an algebra for every n.

concepts.title: Fusion category
concepts.description: A k-linear semisimple abelian rigid monoidal category with finitely many isomorphism classes of simple objects, finite-dimensional morphism spaces, a k-bilinear tensor product and End(1)=k. Over a non-algebraically closed field, simple objects need not be split.

concepts.title: Split fusion category
concepts.description: A fusion category in which every simple object has endomorphism algebra k.

concepts.title: Scalar extension of a linear category
concepts.description: For k⊂K, replace each morphism space Hom(X,Y) by Hom(X,Y)⊗_k K, keeping the same objects and extending composition.

concepts.title: Rational form of a tensor category
concepts.description: For fields k⊂K and a semisimple K-linear abelian tensor category C_K, a rational form over k is a semisimple k-linear abelian tensor category C_k with a tensor equivalence Kar(C_k⊗_k K)≃C_K. The additional tensor structure must be preserved.

concepts.title: Complete rational form of a tensor category
concepts.description: A rational form C_k of C_K for which C_k⊗_k K is already idempotent complete, so C_k⊗_k K≃C_K without adding new summands.

concepts.title: Cyclotomic field
concepts.description: A number field ℚ(ζₙ) generated by a primitive nth root of unity.

concepts.title: Cyclotomic integer
concepts.description: An algebraic integer lying in a cyclotomic field.

concepts.title: Galois conjugate of a fusion category
concepts.description: For a fusion category over ℂ with a complete form over a number field k, apply an embedding k→ℂ to its associativity and other structure coefficients and extend scalars to ℂ. This gives a conjugate tensor category, up to tensor equivalence.

concepts.title: Frobenius–Perron dimension in a fusion category
concepts.description: For a simple object X of a fusion category over ℂ, FPdim(X) is the spectral radius of its fusion matrix, whose entries are multiplicities in X⊗Y. Extend this additively to other objects.

concepts.title: Global dimension of a fusion category
concepts.description: For a fusion category over ℂ, the global dimension is the sum of the intrinsic squared norms of its simple objects. For a spherical structure it is the sum of their squared categorical dimensions.

concepts.title: Brauer's cyclotomic splitting-field theorem
concepts.description: If a finite group G has exponent n, then ℚ(ζₙ) is a splitting field for G: every irreducible complex representation of G has a model over ℚ(ζₙ).

concepts.title: Cyclotomicity of Frobenius–Perron dimensions
concepts.description: The Frobenius–Perron dimension of every object in a fusion category over ℂ is a cyclotomic integer.

concepts.title: Cyclotomicity of global dimensions of fusion categories
concepts.description: The global dimension of a fusion category over ℂ is a cyclotomic integer.

concepts.title: II₁ subfactor
concepts.description: An inclusion N⊂M of von Neumann factors of type II₁.

concepts.title: Jones index
concepts.description: For a II₁ subfactor N⊂M, its index [M:N] is the von Neumann dimension of L²(M) as an N-module, possibly infinite.

concepts.title: Principal even part of a subfactor
concepts.description: For a finite-index II₁ subfactor N⊂M, the tensor category of N–N bimodules generated by L²(M), closing under finite sums, summands and duals.

concepts.title: Dual even part of a subfactor
concepts.description: For a finite-index II₁ subfactor N⊂M, the tensor category of M–M bimodules generated by L²(M)⊗_N L²(M), closing under finite sums, summands and duals.

concepts.title: Principal graph pair of a finite-index subfactor
concepts.description: The pair of rooted bipartite graphs recording tensoring with the generating N–M Hilbert bimodule and its dual. Even vertices are simple N–N or M–M bimodules, odd vertices are simple mixed bimodules, and edge multiplicities count their summands. The graphs may be infinite.

concepts.title: Finite-depth subfactor
concepts.description: A finite-index subfactor whose principal graphs are finite, equivalently whose even parts have only finitely many simple objects.

concepts.title: Haagerup subfactor
concepts.description: The finite-depth hyperfinite II₁ subfactor with index (5+√13)/2 and the Haagerup principal graph pair.

concepts.title: Extended Haagerup subfactor
concepts.description: The finite-depth hyperfinite II₁ subfactor with the extended Haagerup principal graph pair, of index approximately 4.3772.

concepts.title: Principal Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The principal even part of the Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concepts.title: Dual Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The dual even part of the Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concepts.title: Principal extended Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The principal even part of the extended Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concepts.title: Dual extended Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The dual even part of the extended Haagerup subfactor, considered as a fusion category over ℂ.

concepts.title: Drinfeld center of the Haagerup fusion category
concepts.description: The common braided center of the principal and dual Haagerup fusion categories, with the ribbon structure coming from their subfactor construction.

concepts.title: Haagerup planar algebra
concepts.description: The shaded subfactor planar algebra of the Haagerup subfactor. Morrison–Snyder use a rescaled generator and lopsided normalization of it.

concepts.title: Extended Haagerup planar algebra
concepts.description: The shaded subfactor planar algebra of the extended Haagerup subfactor. Morrison–Snyder use a rescaled generator and lopsided normalization of it.

concepts.title: Shaded planar tangle
concepts.description: A disc with interior discs and nonintersecting strings, with an even number of endpoints on each boundary, checkerboard-shaded complementary regions and marked boundary intervals; considered up to the prescribed isotopy.

concepts.title: Shaded planar algebra
concepts.description: Vector spaces P_{n,+},P_{n,−} acted on multilinearly by shaded planar tangles, compatibly with gluing and identity tangles.

concepts.title: Uncappable element of a planar algebra
concepts.description: A box killed by every operation that caps two adjacent boundary points.

concepts.title: Rotational eigenvector in a planar algebra
concepts.description: A nonzero n-box S, n>0, satisfying ρ(S)=ωS for the shading-preserving two-click rotation ρ. Since ρⁿ=id, its eigenvalue ω is an nth root of unity.

concepts.title: Lopsided planar algebra
concepts.description: A connected shaded planar algebra, with one-dimensional 0-box spaces, normalized so the shaded contractible circle evaluates to 1. The unshaded circle then evaluates to the index, the product of the two circle moduli.

concepts.title: Quantum integer
concepts.description: For n≥1, [n]_q=qⁿ⁻¹+qⁿ⁻³+⋯+q¹⁻ⁿ, and [0]_q=0. Equivalently [n]_q=(qⁿ−q⁻ⁿ)/(q−q⁻¹) when the quotient is defined; the Laurent polynomial also specializes at q=±1.

concepts.title: Jones–Wenzl idempotent
concepts.description: The idempotent fₙ in TLₙ(δ) with identity-diagram coefficient 1 and eᵢfₙ=fₙeᵢ=0 for every adjacent cap–cup generator. It exists for all n at generic δ; special parameters require care.

concepts.title: Non-cyclotomicity of the principal Haagerup fusion categories
concepts.description: The principal even parts of the Haagerup and extended Haagerup subfactors have no complete rational form over any cyclotomic field.

concepts.title: Fields of definition of the Haagerup and extended Haagerup fusion categories
concepts.description: For ℓ=0,1 write Hℓᵖ,Hℓᵈ for the principal and dual even parts and Dℓ for the index. Put n=4ℓ+4, choose q with q+q⁻¹=√Dℓ, and let λℓ²=−[n+2]_q/([2]_q²[n]_q). Both even parts have rational forms over ℚ(Dℓ); for ℚ⊂k⊂ℂ, Hℓᵈ has a complete rational form over k iff Dℓ∈k, and Hℓᵖ iff λℓ∈k. The center Z(H₀ᵖ) has a complete rational form as a ribbon category over k iff ζ₃₉∈k.

concepts.title: Galois conjugates of the Haagerup and extended Haagerup fusion categories
concepts.description: Up to tensor equivalence, the principal Haagerup even part has two Galois conjugates and the principal extended Haagerup even part has three. All the nonoriginal conjugates are nonunitary. The normal closures of their complete fields of definition have Galois groups D₈ (order eight) and C₂×A₄, respectively.

concepts.title: Half-braiding
concepts.description: For an object X of a monoidal category C, a natural family of isomorphisms c_Y:X⊗Y→Y⊗X, compatible with tensor products and the unit: c_{Y⊗Z}=(id_Y⊗c_Z)∘(c_Y⊗id_Z), with associators inserted.

concepts.title: Drinfeld center of a monoidal category
concepts.description: For a monoidal category C, its center Z(C) has objects (X,c), where c is a half-braiding on X, and morphisms f:X→X′ compatible with the half-braidings. Tensoring these pairs makes Z(C) braided; C itself need not be braided.

concepts.title: Induction to the Drinfeld center of a fusion category
concepts.description: For a fusion category C over ℂ, the induction functor I:C→Z(C) is the left adjoint to the functor forgetting the half-braiding. Its underlying object is ⊕_V V⊗X⊗V*, summed over simple representatives V.

concepts.title: Module category over a tensor category
concepts.description: A category M with an action C×M→M and coherent associativity and unit isomorphisms.

concepts.title: Dual fusion category
concepts.description: For an indecomposable semisimple module category M over a fusion category C, the category Fun_C(M,M) of module endofunctors, with composition as tensor product.

concepts.title: Internal Hom in a module category
concepts.description: For objects M,N of a module category over C, an internal Hom is an object [M,N] of C with natural bijections Hom_C(X,[M,N])≅Hom_M(X⊗M,N). It exists in the finite semisimple setting used here.

concepts.title: S-matrix of a ribbon fusion category
concepts.description: For a ribbon fusion category over ℂ, the S-matrix is indexed by simple objects; its (X,Y) entry is the categorical trace of c(Y,X)c(X,Y) on X⊗Y. This is the unnormalized Hopf-link convention.

concepts.title: T-matrix of a ribbon fusion category
concepts.description: For a ribbon fusion category over ℂ, the T-matrix is diagonal, with entry at a simple object X equal to the scalar of its ribbon twist θ_X. No additional anomaly scalar is included.

concepts.title: Modular tensor category
concepts.description: A ribbon fusion category over ℂ whose S-matrix is invertible.

concepts.title: Rational forms pass to Drinfeld centers
concepts.description: In the characteristic-zero fusion-category setting, if C_k is a rational form of C_K, the natural functor Z(C_k)⊗_k K→Z(C_K) is fully faithful, dominant, and commutes with induction. Thus Z(C_k) is a braided rational form, with idempotent completion understood.

concepts.title: Rational forms pass to dual fusion categories
concepts.description: In the characteristic-zero fusion-category setting, let M_K be an indecomposable finite semisimple module category over D_K and let D_k,M_k be compatible rational forms. Scalar extension induces a fully faithful dominant functor Fun_{D_k}(M_k,M_k)⊗_k K→Fun_{D_K}(M_K,M_K), so the dual category over k is a rational form of the dual over K.

concepts.title: Category
concepts.description: Objects and morphisms with associative composition and identity morphisms.

concepts.title: Functor
concepts.description: A map of categories preserving objects, morphisms, identities and composition.

concepts.title: Natural transformation
concepts.description: A family of maps between the values of two functors, commuting with every morphism in their source category.

concepts.title: Equivalence of categories
concepts.description: A functor with an inverse up to natural isomorphism.

concepts.title: Strong monoidal functor
concepts.description: A functor equipped with coherent isomorphisms preserving tensor products and the tensor unit.

concepts.title: Tensor equivalence
concepts.description: A strong monoidal functor whose underlying functor is an equivalence of categories.

concepts.title: Monoidal natural transformation
concepts.description: A natural transformation between strong monoidal functors compatible with their tensor-product and unit isomorphisms.

concepts.title: Dual object in a monoidal category
concepts.description: An object paired with another by evaluation and coevaluation maps satisfying the two zigzag identities; left and right duals reverse the order of the factors.

concepts.title: Double-dual functor
concepts.description: The covariant monoidal endofunctor X↦X** obtained by taking a chosen dual twice in a rigid monoidal category.

concepts.title: Endomorphism algebra of an object in a linear category
concepts.description: The vector space End(X), with multiplication given by composition and unit the identity of X.

concepts.title: Idempotent endomorphism
concepts.description: An endomorphism e:X→X satisfying e∘e=e.

concepts.title: Splitting of an idempotent endomorphism
concepts.description: Maps r:X→Y and i:Y→X with ir=e and ri=id_Y exhibit Y as the image of the idempotent e.

concepts.title: Additive category
concepts.description: A category with abelian-group morphism sets, composition additive in each variable, a zero object and finite biproducts.

concepts.title: Abelian category
concepts.description: An additive category with kernels and cokernels in which every monomorphism is a kernel and every epimorphism is a cokernel.

concepts.title: Subobject in a category
concepts.description: An equivalence class of monomorphisms into a fixed object, where two are equivalent if an isomorphism of their domains commutes with the maps.

concepts.title: Zero object in a category
concepts.description: An object 0 of a category such that for every object X there is exactly one morphism 0→X and exactly one morphism X→0.

concepts.title: Finite biproduct in a category
concepts.description: An object with injections and projections making it simultaneously the product and coproduct of a finite family of objects, with the usual compatible identity and zero composites.

concepts.title: Adjoint functors
concepts.description: Functors F:C→D and G:D→C with natural bijections Hom_D(FX,Y)≅Hom_C(X,GY); F is left adjoint to G.

concepts.title: Representable functor
concepts.description: A functor naturally isomorphic to Hom(A,−), or to Hom(−,A) in the contravariant case.

concepts.title: Tensor category over a field
concepts.description: A k-linear abelian rigid monoidal category with a k-bilinear tensor product and End(1)=k, finite-dimensional morphism spaces, and finite length for every object. Semisimplicity and finitely many simple isomorphism classes are not required.

concepts.title: Twist in a braided monoidal category
concepts.description: A natural automorphism θ of the identity with θ₁=id and θ_{X⊗Y}=c_{Y,X}c_{X,Y}(θ_X⊗θ_Y).

concepts.title: Tensor ideal of morphisms in a linear monoidal category
concepts.description: A family of linear subspaces of morphism spaces closed under composition on either side and tensoring with arbitrary morphisms.

concepts.title: Quotient of a linear category by an ideal
concepts.description: For a k-linear category C and a linear ideal I closed under composition on either side, C/I has the same objects and morphism spaces Hom_C(X,Y)/I(X,Y), with induced composition.

concepts.title: Vector space
concepts.description: An abelian group with scalar multiplication by a field, satisfying the distributive and associativity laws.

concepts.title: Bilinear map
concepts.description: A map of two vector-space variables that is linear in each variable separately.

concepts.title: Tensor product of vector spaces
concepts.description: The vector space V⊗W with its universal bilinear map from V×W.

concepts.title: Field
concepts.description: A commutative ring in which 1≠0 and every nonzero element is invertible.

concepts.title: Associative algebra over a field
concepts.description: A vector space with an associative bilinear multiplication and a multiplicative identity.

concepts.title: Module over an associative algebra
concepts.description: A vector space on which the algebra acts linearly, compatibly with multiplication and the identity.

concepts.title: Idempotent element of an algebra
concepts.description: An element e satisfying e²=e.

concepts.title: Orthogonal idempotents in an algebra
concepts.description: Idempotents e and f satisfying ef=fe=0.

concepts.title: Invertible element of an algebra
concepts.description: An element with a two-sided multiplicative inverse.

concepts.title: Split semisimple algebra
concepts.description: A finite-dimensional algebra isomorphic to a finite product of full matrix algebras over its base field.

concepts.title: Temperley–Lieb algebra
concepts.description: TL_n(δ) is spanned by planar noncrossing pairings of n top and n bottom points. Multiply by stacking and replace every closed loop by δ; equivalently its generators satisfy eᵢ²=δeᵢ, eᵢeᵢ₊₁eᵢ=eᵢ and eᵢeⱼ=eⱼeᵢ for abs(i−j)>1.

concepts.title: Colored operad
concepts.description: A collection of operations with specified input and output types, with associative substitution into inputs and identity operations.

concepts.title: Planar isotopy of tangle diagrams
concepts.description: A continuous deformation of embedded diagrams preserving their incidences, boundary components and marked data.

concepts.title: Fusion matrix
concepts.description: For an object X in a fusion category over ℂ, the matrix (N_X)_{Z,Y} records the multiplicity of the simple object Z in X⊗Y. Rows and columns are indexed by simple isomorphism classes.

concepts.title: Grothendieck ring of a fusion category
concepts.description: For a fusion category, the free abelian group on simple isomorphism classes, with addition induced by direct sum and multiplication by tensor product.

concepts.title: Spectral radius of a finite matrix
concepts.description: The maximum absolute value of the complex eigenvalues of the matrix.

concepts.title: Perron–Frobenius theorem for nonnegative matrices
concepts.description: A nonnegative real matrix has a nonnegative eigenvalue equal to its spectral radius. If it is irreducible, that eigenvalue is simple and has a strictly positive eigenvector, unique up to scalar.

concepts.title: Intrinsic squared norm of a simple object in a fusion category
concepts.description: For a simple X in a fusion category over ℂ, choose an isomorphism a:X→X**. The product Tr(a)Tr((a⁻¹)*) is independent of this choice and is called |X|². With a pivotal structure it equals dim(X)dim(X*).
aliases: Squared norm of a simple object in a rigid tensor category

concepts.title: Type II₁ factor
concepts.description: An infinite-dimensional von Neumann algebra with center ℂ1 admitting a faithful normal tracial state.

concepts.title: Hilbert bimodule over von Neumann algebras
concepts.description: An M–N Hilbert bimodule is a Hilbert space with commuting normal unital *-representations of von Neumann algebras M and Nᵒᵖ, giving left M and right N actions.

concepts.title: Tracial L²-space of a finite von Neumann algebra
concepts.description: The Hilbert completion of M for the inner product ⟨x,y⟩=τ(y*x), with the natural left and right multiplication actions.

concepts.title: Connes fusion of Hilbert bimodules
concepts.description: The relative tensor product of an M–N and an N–P Hilbert bimodule, formed using bounded vectors and completion in the canonical relative inner product, producing an M–P Hilbert bimodule.

concepts.title: Von Neumann dimension of a Hilbert module
concepts.description: A Hilbert module over a finite factor is represented by a projection on a sum of copies of L²(M); its dimension is the extended matrix trace of that projection.

concepts.title: Hyperfinite von Neumann algebra
concepts.description: A von Neumann algebra that is the weak closure of an increasing union of finite-dimensional *-subalgebras.

concepts.title: Field extension
concepts.description: An inclusion of one field into another.

concepts.title: Number field
concepts.description: A finite extension of ℚ.

concepts.title: Algebraic integer
concepts.description: A complex number satisfying a monic polynomial with integer coefficients.

concepts.title: Root of unity
concepts.description: In a field, a root of unity is an element ζ with ζⁿ=1 for some positive integer n; its order is the least such n.

concepts.title: Field embedding
concepts.description: An injective homomorphism of fields preserving the multiplicative identity.

concepts.title: Splitting field for a semisimple algebra
concepts.description: For a finite-dimensional semisimple k-algebra A, a splitting field is an extension K/k for which K⊗_k A is a finite product of full matrix algebras over K.

concepts.title: Galois group of a finite Galois extension
concepts.description: The group of field automorphisms of the extension that fix the base field pointwise.

concepts.title: Normal closure of a number field
concepts.description: The smallest normal extension of ℚ inside a fixed algebraic closure that contains the given number field.

concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of finite Galois theory
concepts.description: For a finite Galois extension L/k, intermediate fields correspond bijectively, with inclusions reversed, to subgroups of Gal(L/k), by taking fixed fields.

concepts.title: Set
concepts.description: A collection of distinct elements, regarded as one object.

concepts.title: Natural number
concepts.description: One of 0, 1, 2, …; natural numbers count finite collections.

concepts.title: Function between sets
concepts.description: An assignment taking each element of a specified domain set to exactly one element of a specified codomain set.

concepts.title: Composition of functions
concepts.description: For f:A→B and g:B→C, the composite g∘f:A→C sends x to g(f(x)).

concepts.title: Ordered pair
concepts.description: A pair (x,y) with distinguished first and second entries; (x,y)=(x′,y′) exactly when x=x′ and y=y′.

concepts.title: Cartesian product of sets
concepts.description: A×B is the set of ordered pairs (a,b) with a∈A and b∈B.

concepts.title: Subset
concepts.description: A⊆B means every element of A is an element of B.

concepts.title: Union of a family of sets
concepts.description: The set of elements belonging to at least one member of the family.

concepts.title: Intersection of a family of sets
concepts.description: Inside a specified ambient set, the elements belonging to every member of the family.

concepts.title: Complement of a subset
concepts.description: For A⊆Ω, its complement Ω∖A consists of the elements of Ω that do not belong to A.

concepts.title: Disjoint sets
concepts.description: Two sets are disjoint when they have no common element; a family is pairwise disjoint when every two distinct members are disjoint.

concepts.title: Bijection between sets
concepts.description: A function for which each element of the codomain is the image of exactly one element of the domain.

concepts.title: Sequence in a set
concepts.description: A function from the natural numbers, or the positive natural numbers, to that set.

concepts.title: Binary relation on a set
concepts.description: A subset R⊆S×S; writing xRy means (x,y)∈R.

concepts.title: Partial order
concepts.description: A reflexive, antisymmetric and transitive binary relation, usually written ≤.

concepts.title: Total order
concepts.description: A partial order in which any two elements are comparable.

concepts.title: Least upper bound in a partially ordered set
concepts.description: For A⊆P, its least upper bound is an upper bound s satisfying s≤b for every upper bound b of A, when such an s exists.

concepts.title: Binary operation on a set
concepts.description: A function S×S→S.

concepts.title: Group
concepts.description: A set with an associative binary operation, an identity element, and a two-sided inverse for each element.

concepts.title: Abelian group
concepts.description: A group whose operation is commutative.

concepts.title: Commutative ring with identity
concepts.description: An abelian group under addition, together with an associative commutative multiplication with identity, distributing over addition. The zero ring is allowed.

concepts.title: Ordered field
concepts.description: A field with a total order preserved by addition, in which the product of two positive elements is positive.

concepts.title: Isomorphism in a category
concepts.description: A morphism f:X→Y having an inverse g:Y→X, so gf=id_X and fg=id_Y.

concepts.title: Natural isomorphism
concepts.description: A natural transformation whose component at every object is an isomorphism.

concepts.title: Product of categories
concepts.description: C×D has pairs of objects and pairs of morphisms, with identities and composition defined componentwise.

concepts.title: Bifunctor
concepts.description: A functor C×D→E from a product of two categories to another category.

concepts.title: Extended nonnegative real numbers
concepts.description: The nonnegative real numbers together with a greatest element ∞. Sums involving ∞ equal ∞, and 0·∞ is taken to be 0 when integrating simple functions.

concepts.title: Open interval in the real line
concepts.description: For real a<b, the set (a,b)={x∈ℝ:a<x<b}.

concepts.title: σ-algebra generated by a family of subsets
concepts.description: The smallest σ-algebra containing that family, equivalently the intersection of all σ-algebras on the ambient set that contain it.

concepts.title: Borel σ-algebra on the real line
concepts.description: The σ-algebra on ℝ generated by the open intervals.

concepts.title: Measurable space
concepts.description: A set equipped with a specified σ-algebra of subsets.

concepts.title: Preimage of a subset under a function
concepts.description: For f:A→B and E⊆B, f⁻¹(E)={x∈A:f(x)∈E}.

concepts.title: Measurable map between measurable spaces
concepts.description: A function for which the preimage of each measurable subset of the codomain is measurable in the domain.

concepts.title: Indicator function of a subset
concepts.description: For A⊆Ω, the real function 1_A is 1 on A and 0 on its complement.

concepts.title: Measurable simple real function
concepts.description: A measurable real function with finite range. It can be written as a finite sum ∑ a_i 1_{A_i} with measurable level sets A_i.

concepts.title: Monotonicity of the Lebesgue integral
concepts.description: If 0≤f≤g are measurable functions on a measure space, then ∫f dμ≤∫g dμ, allowing infinite integrals.

concepts.title: Linearity of the Lebesgue integral
concepts.description: If f and g are integrable real functions and a,b are real scalars, then af+bg is integrable and ∫(af+bg)dμ=a∫f dμ+b∫g dμ.

concepts.title: Markov’s inequality for nonnegative random variables
concepts.description: If Y is a nonnegative integrable real random variable and t>0, then P(Y≥t)≤E[Y]/t.
